messages:
Maria C: Quick pulse on HelioHealth (Mar 10-16) — saw an error uptick this week, need a triage and action list.
Alex P: High level? numbers?
Maria C: 5xx rate went from 0.3% -> 2.1% daily avg, timeouts spiking during peak at 11am PST, and several rate_limit responses for embedding-bulk calls.
alertbot: incident: high-5xx-rate @helio — 03/14 11:04 UTC — 5xx rate 2.6% (alert threshold 1.5%)
Jordan S: Quick dump from the logs (samples):
```
/path/v1/generate -> 5xx (502) 280 occurrences
/path/v1/stream -> timeout (504) 110 occurrences
/path/v1/embed/bulk -> 429 (rate_limit) 95 occurrences
```
Jordan S: Top failing endpoints (7d): /v1/generate (53% of errors), /v1/stream (21%), /v1/embed/bulk (18%), others misc
Priya R: Onboarding touchpoint: customer sent us usage spike last week — they started batch-ingests. Could be bursty traffic causing rate_limits.
Alex P: Impact: they're seeing model latency jumps and costs rising due to retries. Renewal flag: low risk but need fix before next billing cycle.
Thomas L: From runtime side: generate endpoint uses continuous batching + KV cache. If batch size suddenly jumps with long seqs it can push queue depth. I'll check autoscaler and batching windows.
Maria C: Action items: 1) Thomas check autoscale/burst policy; 2) Jordan verify 504 source (upstream timeout vs runtime); 3) Priya coordinate throttle guidance + sample rate-limit headers to customer; 4) Alex prepare short note for account (impact + ETA).
Jordan S: Added logs ticket INF-8732 and put SRE on-call for 11:00 PST tomorrow to watch.
Priya R: I'll send a quick template with recommended client-side backoff and a suggested batch size cap (1000 -> 200). pinging @Helio contact.
Thomas L: Small config tweak we can do now: reduce batching window from 50ms -> 25ms for that pool; that'll lower latency at cost of throughput. Will deploy to canary tonight.
Alex P: Thx team. Maria, can you lead the customer comms? Keep it short: what happened, what we changed, expected noise window.
Maria C: Yep — sending note after canary results. Will include measured reduction targets: drop in 5xx to <0.8% and timeouts cut by ~60%.
Alex P: :thumbsup:
Priya R: tagging weekly check-in for next Tue to confirm stability.
